blocks.tamil_translation: Whoever recites the last two ayahs of “Surah al-Baqarah” at night, these two ayahs will suffice him.” Hazrat Abu Mas'ud Ansari (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Two meanings have been given for “the two ayahs will suffice”. The first is that the one who recites them will be protected from all harm throughout that night. The other meaning is that these two ayahs will take the place of the Tahajjud Salah.
(Nawawi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ اَوْسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَاْخُذُ مَضْجَعَهُ يَقْرَأُ سُوْرَةً مِنْ كِتَابِ اللهِ اِلَّا وَكَّلَ اللهُ مَلَكًا فَلَا يَقْرَبُهُ شَيْءٌ يُؤْذِيْهِ حَتَّي يَهُبَّ مَتَي هَبَّ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “When a Muslim goes to his bed and recites any surah from the Holy Qur'an, Allah appoints an angel to protect him. Then, whenever he wakes up, nothing harmful will come near him until he wakes.” Hazrat Shaddad ibn Aws (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ قَرَاَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مِائَةَ آيَةٍ كُتِبَ مِنَ الْقَانِتِيْنَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح علي شرط الشيخين ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي: ٣٠٨/١
blocks.tamil_translation: .”Whoever recites one hundred ayahs in a night will be counted among those who spent that night in ibadah.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ وَتَمِيْمِ نِ الدَّارِيِّ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
